column1: # MagiTranslator Nepali -> Japanese dictionary (jane NeJaGlossary). Not in the APK: published to the
# release "jane-dictionaries" and downloaded / imported by the app (DictionaryStore). Keep the first line.
# Format: nepali<TAB>japanese, one entry per line; lines starting with # are comments.
# Every entry is injected into the Nepali input and its Japanese term becomes a REQUIRED term of the
# translation (TranslationValidator TERM_MISSING is a hard error), so only add Nepali words that:
#  - have one established Japanese equivalent (not ambiguous: नेपाली = Nepali language / person,
#    सम्झौता = contract / compromise, बैठक = meeting / sitting room, कर = tax / insistence,
#    पैसा = money / paisa (1/100 rupee) -> not listed);
#  - are nouns. A term also matches with an attached plural or postposition (अस्पतालमा, साथीहरूलाई),
#  - common spelling variants are listed separately (काठमाडौं / काठमाडौँ, आइतबार / आइतवार).
# JaNeLibraryTest checks the format and the matching behaviour.
# A native speaker should confirm new entries before they are added.
# दाइ / दिदी are also used to address an older stranger, which お兄さん / お姉さん also cover.
# भाइ / बहिनी (younger brother / sister) are also used to address a younger stranger, which 弟 / 妹
